facts.fact: 循气味：Risha 循 vetiver 到门、循血到 Rian——rote 式再演治愈（I died, and I lived...Is my heart beating?）；白百合瓣落指混入 Rian 血。
facts.anchor: Risha followed the scent of vetiver to the portal

facts.fact: 无标点裸句：想诉说求共哀——「please look at my loss and tell me it is terrible, please help me, please grieve with me」——终究没说；Rian 反安慰「This is enough」。
先行者：眼将闭（Angelica 催 now）——Julian 断言城已失；Dante「Phos won't stop until all of Vitae is destroyed...I won't let him get that far」——率先步入光、身影被能量 lashes 溶解。
facts.anchor: I won’t let him get that far.

facts.fact: 亡者之怨：Valentin 又闻到她的恨；It's unfair 在墓地走廊与家中回旋——信仰=家人念她名字的方式；忘川水边曾求成为 lost soul，是名字唤她回家。
别离：身后亡灵哀求她回头相助——女儿久于引魂人；锁骨上的义务项链落下、唯余复仇之担。
facts.anchor: she had been a daughter far longer than she had been a psychopomp.

facts.fact: 兄弟同行：Rian「The Cyrs have a duty to Vaega...But we can't fulfill it here」——Nikolas 会意；Fin 抓住 Nikolas 的手（握紧或松开的迟疑）；兄弟成「Pilgrims to a realm they had only ever known through stories and violence」；Angelica/Cosima 随后、Julian 殿后祈祷保母+déjà vu。
穿门：summer heat 门槛——「There's more to see. / Look up.」——金泪如彗星拖着模糊尾迹坠落——「The end, he realized, could be beautiful.」；他的泪是咸的。
facts.anchor: The end, he realized, could be beautiful.

facts.fact: 收网：落地即 stepwell 盆底（梦中所见那口）——全员被 shimmering net 冻住；金镯手收走弓——包围者持金盾长矛与无名金属长器；领队全身镀金面具+bone-white hair+腰双鞘——「I am Ulshära ost Phos of the Zenith Tower, imperator of Solara, and your warder」——「imprisoned, interrogated, and then given to our god for judgment. May all sins be exposed in His light.」
facts.anchor: May all sins be exposed in His light.
